reason: H0 can set SPNG_DECODE_PROGRESSIVE through its fuzzed flags, but it calls only spng_decode_image and then frees the context. In that mode spng_decode_image returns immediately after validating ri->filter, so H0 never continues the progressive protocol with spng_decode_scanline. Consequently it does not exercise progressive-state handling of subsequent scanlines or the changed next_filter > 4 validation in spng_decode_scanline through the progressive API.
evidence: H0 invokes spng_decode_image(ctx, out, out_size, fmt, flags) exactly once and never invokes spng_decode_scanline or spng_decode_row.
spng_decode_image sets ctx->state = SPNG_STATE_DECODE_INIT, reads ri->filter, checks if(ri->filter > 4), and then returns 0 when flags & SPNG_DECODE_PROGRESSIVE.
The changed spng_decode_scanline reads the following scanline's filter into next_filter and adds if(next_filter > 4) return SPNG_EFILTER.
H0 frees ctx immediately after spng_decode_image, including when that call merely initializes progressive decoding.
recommended_action: Add a progressive-decoding harness path that sets SPNG_DECODE_PROGRESSIVE, then repeatedly calls spng_decode_scanline (and, where appropriate, spng_decode_row) across multiple scanlines until SPNG_EOI or an error, including inputs with invalid first and subsequent filter bytes.
